description: Who Trickster is refusing and why: IP access lists, rate limiters, geo ACLs, and the health of the geo locators that place clients.

panels.title: IP ACL denies/s
panels.description: Decisions per second in which an attached IP access list refused a client (action reject or drop; an unparsable client address is also a deny), summed over lists and scopes. A list that faces the internet normally denies some scanners, so look for a step change in the sparkline rather than at the absolute value, then find the list in the IP access lists row. Listener lists with source: peer count TCP/TLS connections; all others count requests, stream flows or MoQ sessions.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl", verdict="deny"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rate limited/s
panels.description: Events per second a rate limiter refused for being over its limit (HTTP 429 or the configured status, a TCP/TLS reset or close, a dropped UDP datagram). Limiters with action: count never refuse; their over-limit events show as counted in the Rate limiting row. New keys refused by a full key table are in the Limiter table full tile. Quotas are per process, so N replicas admit up to N times a limiter's limit.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="limited"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Limiter table full
panels.description: New keys, over the visible time range, that a rate limiter could not track because its key table (max_keys per process, default 100000) or the shard the key hashed to was full. With max_keys_action: allow (the default) those events pass uncounted and escape the limit; with reject they are refused. Anything above 0 means max_keys is too small for the key cardinality, or something is cycling through keys (for example a scan from many addresses).

targets.expr: sum(increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="full"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Geo ACL denies/s
panels.description: Clients per second that a geo ACL with action: reject refused (HTTP 403 or the configured response, a native-protocol error, a reset stream), counted per HTTP request, per native or MoQ session and per TCP/TLS/UDP flow. A sudden rise on an allow-list ACL often means clients stopped resolving to a location: check the Geo not_found tile.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_geo_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_acl=~"$geo_acl", verdict="deny"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Geo would-deny/s
panels.description: Clients per second that a geo ACL with action: count would have refused; they were allowed (HTTP requests carry an X-Trickster-Geo-Denied header naming the ACL). Use it to size a restriction before switching it to reject. These are allows, not refusals.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_geo_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_acl=~"$geo_acl", verdict="count"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Geo not_found
panels.description: Share of geo locator lookups that returned no location. A low, steady value is normal. A high value usually means trusted_proxies is wrong, so every client resolves to a proxy's private address (an allow-list ACL then refuses everyone and a deny-list ACL silently allows everyone), or, for a header locator, the header is missing or the peer is not a trusted proxy. Exempt clients do no lookup and are not counted. Reads no lookups while no geo ACL looks a client up.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_geo_locator_lookups_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator", result="not_found"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(trickster_geo_locator_lookups_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: IP ACL denials/s by list and scope
panels.description: Denials per second for each IP access list, split by the attachment that enforced it: listener (the listener's own list), path (a path naming its own list) or backend (a path inheriting its backend's list). One list attached to several listeners or backends at the same scope sums into one line; the metric has no listener or backend label. Backend- and path-scope refusals of HTTP requests also count in HTTP Traffic under their status (403 unless configured); listener-scope refusals happen before routing and do not.

targets.expr: sum by (ip_acl, scope) (rate(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl", verdict="deny"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: IP ACL deny ratio by list and scope
panels.description: Share of each list's decisions that were denials. Compare like with like: a listener list with source: peer judges each TCP/TLS connection once at accept, while client_ip lists and route lists judge every request, so their ratios have different denominators. A list with default: deny and few entries, or a trusted_proxies change that makes every client look like the proxy, shows as a ratio jumping toward 100%.

targets.expr: sum by (ip_acl, scope) (rate(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl", verdict="deny"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (ip_acl, scope) (rate(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: IP ACL decisions in range
panels.description: Allowed and denied decisions per list and scope over the visible time range. Every attached list appears, even with no traffic, because its counters start at 0 when the attachment is built; a list removed or renamed by a reload keeps a flat row until the process restarts.

targets.expr: sum by (ip_acl, scope) (increase(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl", verdict="allow"}[$__range]))
sum by (ip_acl, scope) (increase(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl", verdict="deny"}[$__range]))

sum by (ip_acl, scope) (increase(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl", verdict="deny"}[$__range])) / (sum by (ip_acl, scope) (increase(trickster_ip_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", ip_acl=~"$ip_acl"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Rate limiter decisions/s by result
panels.description: Judged events per second across the selected limiters, by result. allowed: under the limit and counted. limited: over the limit and refused. counted: over the limit under action: count, recorded and forwarded. exempt: not counted (the key had no value under missing_key: exempt, or the readiness path). full: a new key the full key table could not track (forwarded uncounted, or refused with max_keys_action: reject). An event is a request on HTTP, a connection, session or datagram on streams, and a session or MoQT request on MoQ.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Over-limit ratio by limiter
panels.description: Share of the events each limiter checked against a bucket (allowed, limited, counted) that were over its limit (limited plus counted); exempt and key-table-full events were never checked and are left out. It reads the same whether the limiter rejects or only counts, so it shows how the limit compares to real traffic. There is no scope label: a limiter attached to both a listener and a route reports both as plane http in one line. Behind a proxy missing from trusted_proxies, client_ip keys collapse into the proxy's key and this ratio climbs.

targets.expr: sum by (limiter, plane) (rate(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result=~"limited|counted"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (limiter, plane) (rate(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result=~"allowed|limited|counted"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Tracked keys (largest process)
panels.description: Buckets each limiter holds, from the process holding the most. max_keys (default 100000) applies per process, so compare this line with the limiter's max_keys; the limit itself is not exported. Each key costs about 110 bytes of heap. A bucket is dropped a little more than two windows after its last event, so the line lags a traffic drop. A reload that changes the limiter's keys, window, limit, max_keys or ipv6_prefix starts it empty; a limiter with no keys holds one bucket.

targets.expr: max by (limiter) (trickster_ratelimit_keys{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter"})

panels.title: Key table full events by limiter
panels.description: New keys per interval that did not fit in a limiter's key table. The table is split into up to 64 shards, so this can start before the tracked-keys line reaches max_keys. Under max_keys_action: allow these events bypass the limit entirely; under reject they are refused. Raise max_keys or narrow the keys when this is steady.

targets.expr: sum by (limiter, plane) (increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="full"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Rate limiter decisions in range
panels.description: Decisions per limiter and plane over the visible time range. Every attached limiter has a row, even with no traffic, because its counters start at 0 when it is attached; a limiter removed by a reload keeps a flat row until restart. Totals are summed over the selected instances, each of which enforces its own quota.

targets.expr: sum by (limiter, plane) (increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="allowed"}[$__range]))
sum by (limiter, plane) (increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="limited"}[$__range]))
sum by (limiter, plane) (increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="counted"}[$__range]))
sum by (limiter, plane) (increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="exempt"}[$__range]))
sum by (limiter, plane) (increase(trickster_ratelimit_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", limiter=~"$limiter", result="full"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Geo ACL decisions/s by verdict
panels.description: Clients judged per second by the selected geo ACLs. allow: located and permitted (or no location with unknown: allow). deny: refused. count: would be refused but the ACL has action: count, so it was allowed. exempt: allowed with no lookup (an exempt prefix, or a private, loopback, link-local or CGNAT address under exempt: private). One HTTP request, native or MoQ session, or TCP/TLS/UDP flow is one decision.

targets.expr: sum by (verdict) (rate(trickster_geo_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_acl=~"$geo_acl"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Geo ACL decisions/s by ACL and plane
panels.description: Clients judged per second, per geo ACL and plane: http (each request through a backend or path route), native (each mysql, postgres, clickhouse or flight-sql session, and each MoQ session) and stream (each tcp, tls or udp flow). Every ACL has counters on all three planes from the start, so planes it never judges are hidden here.

targets.expr: sum by (geo_acl, plane) (rate(trickster_geo_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_acl=~"$geo_acl"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Geo ACL refused (or would refuse) ratio
panels.description: Share of each ACL's decisions that were deny (action: reject) or count (action: count, allowed but would have been refused); one ACL uses one action, so its line is one or the other. A ratio near 100% on an allow-list ACL usually means clients have no location (see the not_found ratio below) rather than an influx of foreign clients.

targets.expr: sum by (geo_acl, plane) (rate(trickster_geo_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_acl=~"$geo_acl", verdict=~"deny|count"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (geo_acl, plane) (rate(trickster_geo_acl_decisions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_acl=~"$geo_acl"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Geo locator lookups/s by result
panels.description: Lookups per second made by geo ACL checks through the selected locators. found: a location was returned. not_found: no location (no entry for the address; for a header locator, a missing or unknown header value or an untrusted peer). error: the locator failed and the client was judged as having no location; header locators never error. Several ACLs sharing a locator add up here; exempt clients do no lookup.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(trickster_geo_locator_lookups_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Geo locator not_found ratio
panels.description: Share of each locator's lookups that found no location. A jump usually means trusted_proxies on the listener is wrong, so every client resolves to a proxy's private address: an allow-list ACL then refuses everyone (noticed at once) and a deny-list ACL allows everyone (not noticed). For a header locator it means the header stopped arriving or the peer is not in trusted_proxies. Dashed lines mark 5% and 25%.

targets.expr: sum by (geo_locator) (rate(trickster_geo_locator_lookups_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator", result="not_found"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (geo_locator) (rate(trickster_geo_locator_lookups_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Geo data file reloads
panels.description: Replacement mmdb or geofeed files a running locator loaded (success) or refused (error) per interval; the first load at start is not counted, and header locators have no files. After an error the last good file keeps serving. A refused file counts once per change, but a missing or unreadable file counts on every check (reload_interval, default 5m) until fixed.

targets.expr: sum by (geo_locator, result) (increase(trickster_geo_locator_reloads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: GeoIP database build per instance
panels.description: For every mmdb locator on every instance: when the loaded database was built (from the file's metadata) and how old that is. Instances that disagree have not all picked up the latest file; a replaced file is loaded within the locator's reload_interval or on a change event. Age turns orange at 30 days and red at 60. geofeed and header locators are not listed.

targets.expr: max by (instance, geo_locator) (trickster_geo_locator_build_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator"} > 0) * 1000
(time() - max by (instance, geo_locator) (trickster_geo_locator_build_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", geo_locator=~"$geo_locator"} > 0)) / 86400
